text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ "Great Detective," huh? I was so, 
sooo happy when Fenomeno-san called me 
that!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'm gonna help out even more and 
more! And become an amazing great 
detective~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Which one should I go with...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan! Are you in trouble? Are you 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Urara-san! Um, well, I'm looking for a 
study guide for the upcoming exam, but 
there are so many that I can't decide.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a study guide...!! Leave it to Great 
Detective Urara~!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Isn't that just a regular notebook 
you're holding?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! You know, I think we should just make 
one with this! A custom study guide that's 
perfect for you, Tarumae-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh... Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll write the formulas using a 
memorization marker pen! That way I can 
check them anytime... and oh, there's 
still space, so I'll jot down mnemonics 
too—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry! I got totally carried 
away... I might end up using up the whole 
notebook in no time.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it at all! If you run 
out of notebook space, we can just go buy 
another one~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
~, Acute-san! Um, are you having trouble 
with something?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I heard there's a delicious pickle shop 
around here, but... I just can't seem to 
find it, dear.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see... No worries! Urara will help you 
look for it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The grandma at this tofu shop is sooo 
super nice! She always gives me candy and 
treats!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And at that bookstore over there, there's 
a grandpa who knows everything! Hearing 
all his stories is so exciting~~!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It feels like a lovely stroll around 
town. Getting to check out all these 
shops... Oh, my?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Here it is, the pickle shop I was 
looking for!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is it! I'm so glad we found 
it~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you for showing me around, 
dear. Since we're here, why don't we stop 
by some of the other shops and do some 
shopping before heading back?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Sending another flashy care package this 
month, huh, Ma... ...How the heck am I 
supposed to pay her back...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
A present for your mom? Great Detective 
Urara will give you a hand~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what the hell?! ...Hey, don't just 
jump into people's business without 
asking!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Everyoooone~~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
When someone sends you a care package, 
what kind of return gift makes you super 
happy~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, hold on! Now everyone and their 
mother knows that I'm trying to get a 
pres— I mean, repay a favor, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But if you need advice, it's way better to 
ask every single person around!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, maybe food they really like!" 
"Consumables are always a safe bet!" 
"Honestly, I'd be happy with whatever I 
get~"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone! —What do you think, 
Espo-san?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
............Whaddya mean, 'what do I 
think.'

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aaaargh, fine! Enough already! Subject 
closed, end of discussion!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Dammit. ...Alright, spit it out! What kind 
of stuff would YOU want as payback, huh?! 
Say whatever you want, ya punk!

One day, while walking through the academy 
grounds—

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Urara-chan! You're the talk of the 
school right now! You became a Great 
Detective, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I'm Great Detective Urara, here to 
solve any problem you've got~!
choice_data_list:
A great detective who solves people's 
troubles?

It's amazing how you're helping everyone, 
Urara.

It's really great of you to help people 
out, Urara.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Tell Urara all about your troubles 
too, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Well... lately I feel like I've been 
lacking stamina.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Then let's go running together! If you 
run lots and looots, you'll be bursting 
with energy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing amazing at all! Urara just 
wants every single person to be smiling 
and happy~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, and of course that means you too, 
Trainer! Come on, smile smile~~!!
